items.title: Rich Teen Stripes
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
Rich gang! What better way to flash that dough with some new drip! Better yet, we've got some stripes! We rocking that premium stuff!

+ 20 unique role-playing skins
+ Modern, luxury attire inspired by anime and culture!

items.title: Millionaire Teens
items.creator: Podcrash
items.description:
Do you want to look like a trendy millionaire? Then this modern city clothing skin pack is perfect for you! Enjoy unique colorful outfits! These teens are all about the wealthy fashion world. Featuring the shiniest gold bracelets, necklaces, and glasses, find your next favorite skin today!

+ 1 free skin
+ 12 total skins
+ Perfect for teens!

items.title: Freestyle Teens
items.creator: Podcrash
items.description:
Best dance style? Without question, freestyle is the best! Just let your body flow to the music and show us what you got!

+ 12 unique role-playing skins
+ Modern, dance attire!

items.title: City Professions
items.creator: Podcrash
items.description:
Are you looking for the perfect modern teen skins to use with your next city roleplay? If that’s the case, our skin pack City Professions is perfect for you! Whether you want to be a police officer, a firefighter, or a teacher, we’ve got you covered! 

- 12 city themed skins
- Perfect for roleplay!

items.title: Dark Mode 2
items.creator: Dig Down Studios
items.description:
When the only task at hand is survival, many strangely resilient and frightening creatures come to power. Our only hope is that they don’t find their way out from the darkness and into the light.
-By Dig Down Studios

items.title: Rainbow Style Skin Pack

items.description:
Turn heads with the rainbow trends of today and be the cutest among your friends! Collection includes some of the most colorful fashion complete with cool hairstyles and sleek pixel designs. 

+ 15 skins

items.title: Safari Animals

Go sightseeing on a safari across the savanna and see how many animals you can discover!

+ 31 safari animals
+ Several animal interactions
+ Craftable and upgradeable jeeps

Among the monsters...

items.title: Skyblock Earth
items.creator: ChewMingo
items.description:
Skyblock Earth! Test your Minecraft knowledge and explore this unique world. Start on a small island in the sky and explore the giant earth island and the surrounding planets. There are many secrets to unfold in this unique skyblock adventure. Are you ready?

By: ChewMingo

items.title: Modern Teen Fashion!
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Fashionable styles are among us! Find the next best cute, modern clothes for teens in this awesome pack! These are the perfect skins for any situation and look great all year round. A modern teen needs clothes to live in the city. So pick them up in this pack today! 

+ 12 skins
+ Cute colorful designs
+ Bright and fun
+ Includes modern attire for boys and girls!

items.title: Bonfire
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
A bonfire is all about hanging out with your friends by the beach with some s'mores and some good laughs. What better way to do that than by looking sleek and fresh! Let's go!

+ 12 unique role-playing skins
+ Modern, luxury attire!

items.title: Cute Demons
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Demons can be cute too! Modern designs and bright, colorful skins mean you get the best styles even while being a little devilish! Have fun and be a little mischievous in the city or the countryside!

+ 12 skins
+ Colorful and fashionable
+ Cute and Cool

items.title: Next Level
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Through every game and every quest, we grow stronger! Who's ready to reach the next level of greatness? Let's go!
- 12 roleplay skins!
- Modern attire inspired by gamers!

items.title: World Celebrations
items.creator: G2Crafted
items.description:
Let's bring the world together through celebration! Every nation of the world has something to celebrate, and in this lively skin pack we honor some of the most festive.

- Mask-up to celebrate Mardi Gras. Defy death by Running with the Bulls. Promote peace while celebrating the Lantern Festival.
- 6 more world celebrations included
- 18 skins (2 free)

items.title: Metal Rex
items.creator: House of How
items.description: It doesn't get more metal than this! Mechanized dinosaur skins designed with neon armor. Take a bit our of your next adventure with 10 different T-rex skins to choose from.

items.title: Crystal Colors

items.description: Dazzling rainbows and magical patterns. This pack is full of colorful gems. 15 crystal skins in all.

items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios

The biggest sports legends have arrived! Whether you like football, tennis, basketball, or other sports, you get to become a legendary athlete! Summer is here so grab a skin and have some fun with your friends!

items.title: Teen Style!

items.title: Lucky Block Simulator
items.creator: Kubo Studios
items.description:
Start from classic lucky blocks and grind your way through five different maps! Discover tons of new lucky blocks, custom pickaxes, pets, upgrades, and many more! Unlock more backpacks with special coins! - introducing LUCKY BLOCK SIMULATOR!

+ Super fun simulator gameplay!
+ Tons of upgrades to unlock! 
+ Custom mining animations!
+ Many hours of gameplay!

By Kuboc Studios.
